This role involves supporting our center by managing worksheets, assisting students, and performing various administrative duties. If you are passionate about working with children and are committed to contributing to their educational growth, we encourage you to apply. Duties & Responsibilities: Accurately mark and record students' worksheets. Prepare and organize worksheets for upcoming classes. Observe and assist students to ensure they are effectively engaged in their learning. Carry out administrative and management tasks as needed. Communicate students' progress to chief instructor regularly. Expected Profile of Candidates Languages: Khmer - Good English - Medium Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree Undergraduate Degree Skills & Knowledge: General & Technical Skills Open to fresh graduates, undergraduates, and college students. Proficiency in both English and Mathematics. Soft Skills A genuine interest in working with children, with a patient, pleasant, and responsible attitude.
